title: IT Operations Engineer
teaser: IT Operations Engineer with 3 years of experience in IT or Telecom Industry, responsible for managing IT operation for HK and overseas.
jd:
About the role
We are seeking a proactive IT Operations Engineer to manage our local infrastructure and regional operations. In this role, you will bring exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to rapidly resolve complex network and system issues, ensuring seamless connectivity and operational efficiency across Hong Kong and the APAC region (Singapore and Malaysia).
>
Responsibilities
Assist to set up network solutions (LAN, VPN, SD-WAN) and data center networks for both Hong Kong and overseas branches.
Monitor regional network performance with network team, maintain hardware, including routers, switches, firewalls, desktop computers, laptops, IP phone and IT equipment.
Oversee and maintain master administrative access for all core network platforms, business systems, and user permissions across the region.
Troubleshoot and manage core business applications, including ITSM (ManageEngine) & ERP systems (Oracle Netsuite), Microsoft Office, and business software for local and overseas offices/remote users.
Implement security measures and monitor systems to prevent security breaches across all regional network environments.
Coordinate with local vendors and service providers to manage system implementation, maintenance, upgrades, and license renewals.
Provide guidance and training to users on the use of various IT systems and applications.
Maintain clear, updated technical documentation of all local and overseas network configurations.
>
Requirements
Higher Diploma or above in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
3 years of experience in IT or Telecom Industry or Cybersecurity.
Proficiency in Network Infrastructure, Network and Security Solutions, Network Protocols, Firewall Operations, Routing, and Switching.
Good command of spoken and written English, Cantonese and Mandarin.
Willing and able to travel business trips in APAC and Mainland China region.
>
If you have strong troubleshooting skills and experience in managing both local and overseas network operations, we want to hear from you. Submit your application today!

At ARINC Inc., we are at the forefront of innovation in the aviation industry, providing top-tier IT services that ensure the smooth operation of airports worldwide. Join us and be part of a dynamic team that values your skills and invests in your future!

>- Skills: Excellent organizational skills with a high level of flexibility.
>- Language: Chinese and English. Good English communication skill is preferred.

>- Comprehensive Medical Insurance: We care about your health and well-being.
>- On-the-Job Training: Continuous learning and development opportunities to enhance your skills.

title: Director of Information Technology
teaser: Responsible for for leading the strategic roadmap, operational excellence, and lifecycle governance of all IT and AV environments across the Club.
jd:
The Director of Information Technology is responsible for leading the strategic roadmap, operational excellence, and lifecycle governance of all Information Technology (IT) and Audio-Visual (AV) environments across the Club. This executive role oversees enterprise systems, cybersecurity architecture, network infrastructure, event AV production, background music (BGM) distribution, and technological alignment with overall club business objectives.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on, strategic technology leader capable of establishing a pragmatic defense-in-depth security posture, modernizing AV/event operational capabilities and maintaining high-availability hospitality systems (POS, ERP, Member Portal). Additionally, the Director must be able to articulate technical concepts as the primary technology advisor to the Digital Infrastructure Committee and Senior Leadership – bridging the gap between daily operational realities and the Club’s multi-year enterprise architecture vision.
Job Duties & Responsibilities
a) Cybersecurity & Defense Architecture
Establish, operationalize, and enforce a robust defense-in-depth security framework (e.g., NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001) across on-premise networks, cloud workloads, and IoT/AV endpoints
Proactively manage endpoint detection and response (EDR), Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), Identity and Access Management (IAM/MFA), network segmentation (VLANs), and email security gateways to mitigate threats
Lead incident response planning, root-cause analysis, vulnerability remediation, and staff security awareness training to prevent recurring security incidents
Ensure compliance with data privacy standards, data backup integrity, disaster recovery (DR) testing, and business continuity protocols
b) Audio-Visual (AV), Event Tech & Background Music (BGM) Operations
Architect, configure, and maintain the Club's dedicated AV network infrastructure , including AV-over-IP architectures, digital signal processors (DSPs), zoned BGM distribution, and digital signage
Ensure seamless execution and zero-downtime AV operational support for high-profile Club banquets, private member events, corporate seminars, and hybrid board meetings
Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs), proactive diagnostic routines, and rapid-response workflows to eliminate audio dropouts, video routing latency, and display failures
Evaluate emerging AV and smart facility technologies (e.g., Dante audio, Crestron/Q-SYS automation, wireless mic frequency management, LED wall staging) to elevate member event experiences
c) Enterprise Infrastructure & Cloud Systems
Maintain high availability, performance, and monitoring for core hospitality and club management systems, including Point of Sale (POS), Club ERP / CRM, HRMS, and digital communications platforms (e-news, member app, digital signage)
Administer Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant security, Entra ID, Microsoft cloud environments, Amazon Web Services hosting, and physical/virtual server infrastructure
Oversee wired/wireless network topology (switches, access points, guest/staff captive portals), ensuring optimal bandwidth allocation between hospitality POS traffic, member Wi-Fi, and AV data streams
d) Leadership, Financial Governance & Vendor Management
Manage the IT & AV operational (OPEX) and capital (CAPEX) budgets, maximizing return on technology investments and optimizing service licensing costs
Negotiate, manage, and regularly evaluate SLAs and performance metrics for third-party hardware/software vendors, telecommunications carriers, MSPs, and AV integrators
Serve as the primary technology advisor and liaison to Club Management, General Committees, and Department Heads
Lead, mentor, and upskill the IT and AV support team, fostering a culture of technical curiosity, member-first customer service, and proactive troubleshooting
Qualifications & Requirements:

jd:
About the Company
SIMSQ HK LIMITED is an e-commerce company focusing on travel, postpaid, IoT and other innovative products. Our core strength lies in combining information technology and telecommunications technology to deliver our products to the global market. The business operates through our Shopify store and mobile apps, with a telecom-carrier backend; our technical team (backend, frontend and QA) is based in Shenzhen.
This role spans telecom, e-commerce and cross-border collaboration — a combination of experience rarely found in the market — with room to lead a growing team and advance as the business scales.
Position Summary
We are hiring a full-time Technical Product Manager based in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong. Reporting directly to management, the Technical Product Manager serves as the link between the Hong Kong business functions and the Shenzhen-based technical team, and owns the full requirement lifecycle for the company’s eSIM, physical SIM, top-up, wholesale-channel and postpaid products — from gathering and analysing business needs, through specification and delivery planning, to release and post-launch follow-up.
Key Competencies
• Requirements gathering and analysis: communicates effectively with non-technical colleagues and reports clearly to management
• Project management: plans, tracks and delivers each requirement on time with a remote technical team
This is a hands-on position: the incumbent personally analyses requirements and writes the specifications rather than coordinating the work of others. Prior telecom experience is an advantage but not a requirement.
Collaboration with the Shenzhen technical team is primarily online. More frequent visits to the Shenzhen (Nanshan) office are expected during the initial months to establish working relationships, with travel arranged as needed thereafter. Transport and accommodation are provided by the company.
Key Responsibilities
Requirements and Stakeholder Communication
• Gather requirements from management and business functions (operations, customer service, marketing and sales); analyse the underlying business need and confirm scope and priority with management
• Translate requirements into business flows, functional specifications, product requirements documents (PRDs) and acceptance criteria that are clear to both non-technical stakeholders and the technical team
• Explain technical constraints, options and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders in plain language, and convey business context accurately to the technical team
• Provide regular progress, risk and go-live reporting to management and obtain sign-off at key milestones
Project Management and Delivery
• Develop and maintain the delivery plan for each requirement, including owner, timeline, milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria
• Coordinate the Shenzhen technical team (backend, frontend and QA) and Hong Kong stakeholders; monitor progress, resolve blockers and escalate risks in a timely manner
• Manage online store and mobile app releases: confirm testing and rollback plans prior to release, oversee go-live verification and follow up on post-release issues
• Lead the response to production incidents: establish the facts, keep affected functions informed, support management decisions on delay, fix or rollback, and follow up on remediation and post-incident reviews
• Maintain PRDs, SOPs, release checklists, meeting action items and the team knowledge base
Requirements

jd:
Who We Are
>
Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.
Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.
Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.
At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.
If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!
>
Summary/Objective
The On-site Airline Support Specialist will support our airline client overnight, located onsite at the client’s office.
The On-site Airline Support Specialist is the primary point of contact for both the client and vendor regarding API’s operations. In this role, the On-site Airline Support Specialist processes reservations and cancellations, maintains and cultivates successful relationships with our airline partner as well as our suppliers, and sometimes directly with the crew. Maintaining a strong focus on providing the best customer service at all times. This includes internal collaboration within the airline and API, as well as communication with external parties to ensure that operational challenges are resolved promptly and seamlessly. The initial steps will require manual detail proficiency:
Transmitting monthly schedules to the hotels and ground transportation suppliers
Update and transmit daily changes to the hotels and ground transportation suppliers
Communication with the hotels and ground transportation suppliers during day-of-ops for immediate changes
Book overflow room as required at non-contracted hotels
Interrogating the airline’s crew management system (CMS) to identify existing reservations and update new reservations
Receiving calls from crew members to verify their hotel details and chase delayed ground transport
>
Essential Functions
We will train you on our work policies, procedures, and the ACES system to get you delivering Ops support. You will then address client needs and provide solutions with the support of your API colleagues. Your follow-up on client requests is key to Client satisfaction, ensuring you always resolve a request as well as process and prioritise all client requests. You will build and maintain business relationships with clients by providing a great customer experience.
The On-site Airline Support Specialist provides total customer service, including but not limited to the following:
Effectively use all available tools and methodology, i.e., phone, email, fax, and Reservation Systems (ACES, Hotel Express, DPAX, IHRS) to track and provide solutions to client needs, requests, and overall expectations. Adapt to the situation at hand, e.g., (IROP) or (other), to accommodate needs created due to the changing dynamics of airline schedules or unforeseen situations.
Provides support, guidance, and training, working as the on-site liaison with the airline partner.
Processes client requests received from the airline through the API Operations system. Assesses all customer needs. Responds in a prompt, well-informed, accurate, and professional manner.
Follows up on all client requests and transactions. All tasks must be fully executed, and client satisfaction is critical.
Alerts supervisor on all items of critical nature that require management involvement to solve and/or avoid potential challenges that may impact either the client or API adversely.
Negotiates with vendors (Hotels, Ground Transportation, others) to achieve the best outcome for the client and API.
Resolves client disagreements calmly and professionally. Researches and presents solutions to satisfy client needs based on facts.
Effectively utilizes all available tools and methodology, i.e., phone, email, fax, and Reservation Systems (ACES, Hotel Express, DPAX, IHRS) to track and provide solutions to client needs, requests, and overall expectations.
Adapts to the situation at hand, e.g., Irregular Operations (IROP) or other challenges to accommodate needs arising from the changing dynamics of airline schedules or unforeseen situations. This includes and is not limited to extended work schedules. Must be on the official “On Call Roster” when needed outside of regular working hours.
Maintains knowledge of API’s call centre work methodology and reservation systems that will best serve API’s clients most efficiently and professionally.
>
Qualifications/Experience
You will have one to two years’ experience in the hotel/travel industry. Experience in the airline industry is a definite plus: airline crew/ scheduling and/or crew planning.
Prior experience with GDS systems, hotel reservation systems, airline reservation systems, and/or related functions preferred but not required.
Possess outstanding relationship management and customer service skills.
Knowledge of Hotels as a product: hotel chains, categories, and locations.
Knowledge of Ground Transportation reservations.
Track record of delivering to deadlines.
Track record of operating successfully in a dynamic role.
The ability to prioritise work provided by others in terms of importance is imperative to this position.
Demonstrate strong communication skills, including active listening.

title: Primary Teaching Assistant (SEN 1:1 Support) (Lower Primary)
teaser: Primary Teaching Assistant (SEN 1:1 Support) providing individualized academic and behavioural support to a Lower Primary student.
jd:
About Bloom KKCA Academy
Founded by educators, entrepreneurs, and engineers, Bloom KKCA Academy is an innovative, project-based, bilingual school for G1-6 students. From a NASA engineer to a certified forest school educator, our teachers are what make Bloom special. Our approach to education is to look past conventional expectations to attend to the child in front of us, the whole child, full of unique potential. Our bilingual curriculum (Mandarin and English) combines a project-based approach with research-based, academically rigorous programs. Our founding team shares an intense passion for changing the way education prepares students for the future. We have led academic programs at top local and international schools on five continents, and we are excited to bring those diverse perspectives to building Bloom KKCA Academy. Learn more at www.bloom.edu.hk.
>
Position Overview
We are seeking a dedicated, empathetic, and skilled Primary Teaching Assistant (SEN 1:1 Support) to provide comprehensive, individualized academic, socio-emotional, and behavioural support to a Lower Primary student with complex learning needs. You will play a vital role in helping the pupil develop self-regulation, social communication, and a positive self-concept, while enabling them to meaningfully access our innovative bilingual curriculum through tailored differentiation, accommodations, and positive reinforcement.
In addition to individual student support, a Bloom KKCA Academy Teaching Assistant actively collaborates with homeroom teachers, the Learning Support Coordinator, the Pastoral Team, and external professionals. Successful candidates will bring a reflective, flexible, and hands-on approach, acting as an essential bridge between classroom learning, specialized intervention, and family communication within our vibrant, community-centered environment.
Key responsibilities
Individualized Student Support & Learning Facilitation: Aid the pupil to learn as effectively as possible in both individual and group settings by clarifying instructions, breaking down learning tasks, motivating efforts, and assisting in targeted areas such as speech & language, reading, spelling, numeracy, and handwriting.
Differentiation & Curriculum Access: Plan, design, and implement differentiated materials, activities, and accommodations to ensure the pupil is appropriately challenged, highly engaged, and able to access the curriculum safely and effectively.
Socio-Emotional & Behavioural Guidance: Consistently implement agreed self-regulation and behavioural strategies; provide commentary, positive encouragement, and praise to foster concentration, resilience, self-reliance, and self-esteem.
Inclusion & Social Skills Development: Promote acceptance and full inclusion of the pupil within the school community, supporting social communication and positive peer interactions both inside the classroom and during unstructured times (break, lunch, and transitions).
Collaboration & Multidisciplinary Liaison: Work collaboratively with Homeroom Teachers, Learning Support Coordinator, Pastoral Team, and external therapists to contribute to the planning, delivery, and ongoing review of the pupil’s individual educational goals.
Observation, Documentation & Feedback: Maintain accurate, systematic, and confidential documentation of pupil observations, progress, and behavioral response; provide timely feedback to relevant staff and parents at agreed intervals.
Child Protection & Safeguarding: Know and rigorously apply school policies regarding Child Protection, Safeguarding, Health & Safety, Behaviour, Equal Opportunities, and confidential issues linked to home/school relations.
Professional Growth & Community Engagement: Actively participate in school training activities, professional development, and staff meetings to continuously enhance knowledge and skills in working with children with specific learning needs; undertake general supervision duties as requested by school leadership.
>
Key Requirements:
Knowledge, Abilities, Characteristics, and Interests
Knowledge of:
Child growth and development
Current trends, research, and best practices
Primary content areas
Ability to:
Employ varied teaching methods
Create a positive and productive learning environment
Motivate students, colleagues, and key stakeholders
Handle problems and concerns with sensitivity and tact
Confidently and competently communicate orally and in writing with students, parents, and others
Plan, establish priorities, and implement activities and performances of understanding for maximum effectiveness
Embrace hands-on and project-based learning that is interdisciplinary
Use a range of assessments to determine student achievement and then analyze results in order to determine actions for improvement
Work effectively, flexibility and adaptability with colleagues, families, and students from different backgrounds and beliefs
Value unique perspectives, experiences, and personalities to build relationships
Characteristics:
Organized and efficient
Critical and creative thinker
Inter-culturally aware with well-developed interpersonal skills
Approachable and positive
Innovative and flexible
Comfortable working and flourishing in an ever-changing environment
Self-starter, proactive, and an active learner
Interests
Creativity and innovation
Hands-on learning
Positive education
Multiculturalism
Professional development
Collaboration
>
Person Specification
Required Qualifications & Experience
Higher Diploma in Education, Special Education, Psychology, or related disciplines (or above); part-time PGDE students are welcome.
Previous experience in a similar 1:1 SEN support or classroom teaching assistant role within a school setting is required.
Fluent English speaker with excellent written and spoken communication skills.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with multi-disciplinary teams and families.
Demonstrated commitment to safeguarding, child protection, and equal opportunities.
Satisfactory background check and child protection clearance.
>Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency in spoken Mandarin and/or Cantonese is highly desirable.
Specialized training or certifications in SEN support, positive behaviour intervention, or speech/language assistance.
Good ICT skills and experience using technology to support learning and documentation.
Collaborative, positive, and inclusive approach — we strongly value harmony among staff.
>
Qualified candidates will be remunerated with a competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience. To apply, please email your cover letter, resume, and educational philosophy to ••••@bloom.edu.hk . Personal information will be used for recruitment purposes only. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Successful candidates will be expected to begin immediately.
>

title: Director, IT Operations & Information Security, Asia
teaser: For design, implementation, security, and day-to-day operation of IT infrastructure, network services, security and technology implementations

Double pay, Bonus, 5-day work week, Medical Insurance
Chai Wan (commercial building and close to MTR station)
jd:
About the role
The Director, IT Operations and Information Security, Asia is responsible for the design, implementation, security, and day-to-day operation of IT infrastructure, network services, security and technology implementations across the company's Asia-based offices and manufacturing sites in Hong Kong, Dongguan (China), Vietnam, other locations in Asia, and potentially other international sales marketing offices in accordance with Jazwares Global Technology mandates, policies and procedures. This role serves as the regional extension of the Global Information Security and Infrastructure function, ensuring local operations align with corporate security policy, regulatory compliance obligations, and enterprise technology standards. The Director also serves as the primary IT escalation point and trusted technology partner for Asia-based business and plant leadership.
This role leads a small team, governs the Managed Service Provider (MSP) relationship in each APAC office/region, and serves as the region's Senior IT and Security decision-maker and escalation point. The Director also carries information security governance responsibility for the region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Infrastructure & Network Operations
Own and manage LAN/WAN, wireless, firewall, and data center/server infrastructure across all Asia sites.
Manage relationships and SLAs with regional ISPs, MPLS/SD-WAN providers, and telecommunications vendors.
Ensure network uptime, capacity planning, and disaster recovery/business continuity readiness for each site.
Own regional network, server, and cloud infrastructure health, availability, and performance across all APAC sites Drive remediation of various assessment findings (Technology and InfoSec) to closure
Drive adoption of and ongoing compliance with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA/Zscaler), identity (Okta), and endpoint security (SentinelOne EDR) programs across the region, aligned to Jazwares' global security architecture
Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans for regional infrastructure and operations, including recovery testing
Technical Support Desk
Maintaining workforce productivity and operational efficiency
Incident & Ticket Management: Oversee the IT ticketing system, ensuring all incidents and service requests are documented, prioritized, and resolved within established service level agreements (SLAs).
End-User Technical Support: Provide first- and second-level technical assistance for hardware, software, operating systems, and connectivity issues (Windows/macOS), including on-site and remote support.
Identity & Access Management: Facilitate secure onboarding and offboarding processes, including account creation/disabling, permission management, and MFA enrollment.
Maintain an accurate Asia region asset inventory covering servers, network devices, and endpoints.
Vendor & Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with third-party vendors and other IT teams to resolve complex issues and implement enterprise technology solutions.
Support for Communication Tools: Provide technical support for A/V equipment, web conferencing platforms, and telecommunications systems to ensure seamless business operations.
Information Security
Execute and localize the global information security program across Asia sites, including endpoint protection, patch management, vulnerability management, access controls, and incident response.
Ensure compliance with regional data privacy and cybersecurity regulations, including China's Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL) and Cybersecurity Law, Vietnam's data localization requirements, and Hong Kong's Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO).
Serve as the regional point of contact for security incidents, coordinating with the global Security Operations Center (SOC) and security leadership.
Support cross-border data transfer requirements and data residency obligations given the multi-country operating footprint.
Compliance & Risk
Support Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) IT General Controls (ITGC) testing, evidence collection, and remediation across Asia-based systems.
Maintain audit-ready documentation for infrastructure, access controls, and change management processes.
Partner with Internal Audit and Legal on data residency, export control, and trade/customs IT considerations relevant to manufacturing operations.
Provide training and guidance to regional staff and end users on IT systems, security practices, and policies, Support policy distribution, acknowledgment, and tracking.
Security awareness: ensure all APAC staff and MSP personnel complete role-based security awareness training and phishing simulations.
Escalate policy non-compliance in a timely manner and coordinate with local HR on remediation
Team & Vendor Management
Manage local IT staff and/or managed service providers (MSPs) across Hong Kong, Dongguan, and Vietnam.
Manage regional budget for IT infrastructure, hardware refresh cycles, and vendor/telecom contracts.
Standardize hardware, software imaging, and end-user support processes across all sites.
Directly manage and develop the Dongguan-based infrastructure and technical support staff, including work direction, staff performance, and career development
Own performance, SLA compliance, and contract governance for the Managed Service Providers (MSPs) supporting each office/region, ensuring contracts include SLAs, Data Processing Agreements (DPA), right-to-audit and security-requirement clauses; run regular service reviews against defined KPIs; and oversee MSP identity, access, and awareness controls
Business Partnership & Project Delivery
Act as the senior IT presence for Asia leadership, including plant managers and Hong Kong regional leadership.
Lead regional technology projects such as ERP rollouts, network upgrades, site expansions or relocations, and M&A integration activity.
Translate corporate IT and security strategy into actionable regional execution plans.
Partner with Physical Security to secure sensitive areas such as server and network rooms and labs, including physical access logging and CCTV coverage.
Governance & Reporting
Prepare and delivery regular reports on regional system health, security posture, project status, and MSP performance Help facilitate periodic access reviews
Report key metrics — uptime, security posture, incident trends, and project status — to the VP, Information Security and Network Infrastructure and other stakeholders.
Participate in global IT leadership planning as the voice of the Asia region.
Serve as the primary APAC-region escalation point for infrastructure, technical support, and security incidents
Travel to the APAC offices on an occasional (quarterly or as-needed) basis to support site operations, vendor reviews, and team development
Represent the region in global IT infrastructure strategy, planning, and change management processes (e.g., Change Advisory Board)
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, network, security roles, including 3–5+ years in a regional or multi-site leadership capacity.
Strong technical foundation across infrastructure domains (networking, servers, cloud, endpoint) sufficient to direct, evaluate, and escalate technical work performed by direct reports and MSP
Experience supporting manufacturing or multi-site operations in China and Southeast Asia.
Strong knowledge of network architecture (SD-WAN, firewalls, wireless) and security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001).
Experience operating within a SOX-compliant, public company environment.
Familiarity with China, Hong Kong, and Vietnam data privacy and IT regulatory requirements.
Demonstrated vendor management and budget ownership experience.
Experience managing outsourced or Managed Service Provider (MSP) relationships, including SLA governance and vendor performance management .
Experience administering Google Workspace, Okta, Zscaler, ManageEngine, Iru and SentinelOne (or equivalent identity/ZTNA/EDR platforms
Proven leadership and people-management skills, including the ability to develop, coach, and manage the performance of technical staff
Working knowledge of information security governance and controls: Zero Trust; identity, SSO, MFA, and device trust (Okta); privileged access management (CyberArk); EDR (SentinelOne); ZTNA (Zscaler); network access control and segmentation; vulnerability management (Rapid7); data classification and DLP; and MDM
Experience supporting information security incidents • Familiarity with the NIST CSF and CIS Controls, with the ability to run regional governance against a global security baseline and industry standards
Solid understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure administration
Working knowledge of regional data privacy and security compliance frameworks applicable to mainland China, Hong Kong, Vietnam
Experience with ITSM/ticketing practices and driving service-desk maturity
Ability to operate independently as the senior IT leader in the region, exercising sound judgment on escalations without daily direct oversight
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to translate technical and security issues into business terms for US-based leadership
Sound business, financial, and vendor-negotiation judgment, including experience managing regional IT budgets and contracts
Relevant certifications such as CISCP, CCNP, or PMP (preferred).
Proficiency in English and Putonghua (written/spoken);
Willingness and ability to travel regularly between Hong Kong, Dongguan (China), and Vietnam, with occasional travel to other locations in Asia and international offices.

Work in Hong Kong's most visually stunning, futuristic tech-education space.
Standard Annual Leave, MPF, and performance incentives.
The rare opportunity to be a core management pillar in a rapidly growing, elite startup.

If you have the operational precision of a mission controller, we want to hear from you!
Join HKATA today. Code the Universe. Engineer the Future.

teaser: Responsible for leading cybersecurity, network, on-premises and cloud infrastructure.
jd:
McDonald's is a leading fast-food chain committed to delivering quality, convenience, and value to our customers. With a strong presence across Hong Kong, we are dedicated to providing excellent service and innovative offerings that cater to the diverse tastes of our community. As an Head of Infrastructure and Security, you are responsible for leading cybersecurity, network, on-premises and cloud infrastructure to ensure the availability, security, resilience and compliance of core corporate technology services across McDonald’s Hong Kong office and more than 260 restaurants.
The role reports directly to the Head of Technology and partners with business stakeholders, McDonald’s Global Technology and Cybersecurity teams, and external service providers to deliver secure, scalable, and standardized solutions that support business growth and transformation.
Responsibilities:
Leadership and Governance
Lead a small team covering cybersecurity, network infrastructure, and office helpdesk support within the Technology department to deliver stable and secure technology services.
Partner with business stakeholders, Global Technology, and external service providers to define and deliver secure, scalable, and standardized technology architecture and policies that support business needs and ensure compliance with Global Cybersecurity policies and standards.
Security
Manage SOC services, security monitoring, incident response support, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity maturity improvement.
Develop and maintain IT policies, standards, procedures, and business contingency and DR plans to reduce business and IT risk.
Drive continuous improvement of security controls across enterprise and restaurant infrastructure, applications, and network architecture.
Coordinate IT audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and remediation follow-up.
Infrastructure
Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives, including hybrid cloud operations, network transformation, and business continuity planning for offices and data centres.
Co-manage NOC services with Restaurant Support Team to monitor network performance and support troubleshooting across restaurants.
Manage budgets for infrastructure, cybersecurity, and end-user support services, ensuring cost control and service effectiveness.
Manage vendors and outsourced partners to ensure service quality, SLA compliance, and contractual performance.
Oversee end-user support for office-based users, including troubleshooting of desktop, laptop, printer, mobile device, account, and application issues.
Requirements :
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, network operations, cybersecurity and cloud technology.
At least 3 to 5 years of leadership experience managing an IT function or equivalent senior leadership role with responsibility for people, budgets, and service delivery.
Strong experience supporting enterprise office users and managing helpdesk or service desk operations.
Proven experience in multi-site enterprise environments, preferably retail, hospitality, or other distributed business operations.
Solid knowledge of security operations, infrastructure transformation, hybrid cloud environments, and business continuity planning.
Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, and budget control experience.
Key Competencies :
Agility in supporting business needs across both office and restaurant operations.
Good judgment in balancing business priorities with technical risk, feasibility, and standards.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders.
Professional certifications in cybersecurity, cloud, or service management, such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or ITIL, are an advantage.

jd:
About the Role
>We are building a resilient network stack to ensure our users can reliably access our services in regions with heavy censorship (e.g., Chinese, India). You will design, deploy, and maintain obfuscation layers (Shadowsocks, obfs4proxy, Cloudflare Tunnel) and implement strategies such as traffic masking, IP rotation, and automated failover to keep our infrastructure accessible.
Responsibilities
Design, deploy, and maintain proxy/obfuscation stacks (Shadowsocks, obfs4proxy, Cloudflare Tunnel, etc.)
Monitor and mitigate censorship-related disruptions (DPI, DNS poisoning, TCP reset injection, etc.)
Develop a strategy for traffic masking and IP hopping with Chocolate protocols
Collaborate with the backend team to ensure seamless application connectivity under censorship pressure
Research and adopt new circumvention techniques (TLS camo, domain fronting, randomized transports)
Implement observability & logging for health checks, traffic anomalies, and tunnel stability
Requirements
Must-Have Qualifications
Strong Linux system administration and networking fundamentals
Familiarity with proxy and tunneling technologies (Shadowsocks, V2Ray, obfs4proxy, WireGuard, etc.)
Practical knowledge of censorship mechanisms (deep packet inspection, IP/port blocking, DNS manipulation)
Solid scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar)
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Knowledge of TLS fingerprinting evasion (uTLS, camouflage transports)
Experience with Cloudflare Spectrum/Tunnel/Magic Transit or similar services
Awareness of BGP security, RPKI, and route hijack prevention
Security background in encrypted communications and adversarial networks
Some Go or Rust experience (to tweak or build transport proxies if needed)
Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes) and CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible, etc.)
Benefits
Why Join Us?
Work on cutting-edge infrastructure to fight censorship and ensure open access
Freedom to research, test, and implement creative networking solutions
Remote-friendly team with flexible working hours
Opportunity to make a real-world impact on internet freedom

title: 網絡數通工程師

jd:
職位名稱：網絡數通工程師
工作地點： 中國香港

職位概述
我們正在尋找具備扎實華爲數通産品知識與豐富項目交付經驗的網絡工程師，加入香港項目交付團隊。您將負責企業級網絡項目的全生命周期交付，涵蓋從網絡建設、割接實施到售後運維的全流程，確保爲客戶提供高效、穩定的網絡服務。
崗位職責
1. 網絡項目交付與實施
負責華爲數通産品（如路由器、交換機、防火墻、WLAN、SDN解决方案等）的項目交付工作，包括設備安裝調試、配置、驗收測試等。
主導或參與網絡割接、遷移及升級項目，確保操作過程中業務最小化中斷，幷撰寫割接方案與實施報告。
2. 網絡運維與售後支持
負責重點客戶的網絡日常維護，提供二綫/三綫技術支持，快速響應幷解决複雜的網絡故障（如路由環路、BGP/OSPF震蕩、QoS策略問題等）。
定期執行網絡健康檢查，優化網絡架構與性能，確保網絡的高可用性與安全性。
3. 文檔與流程規範
編寫清晰的技術交付文檔、網絡拓撲圖、操作流程（SOP）及故障處理報告。
嚴格遵守項目施工規範與驗收標準，確保交付質量符合客戶及行業標準。
任職要求
1. 必備條件
工作經驗： 具備 2-3年 項目工作經驗，或等同的系統集成商（SI）網絡項目實施經驗。
證書要求： 必須持有有效的 華爲HCIE證書 （方向：Datacom 或 Routing & Switching）。
專業技能：
精通路由交換技術（如OSPF、BGP、VLAN、STP、MPLS等），具備獨立排查網絡故障的能力。
熟悉華爲全系列數通産品（如NE/AR系列路由器、S系列交換機、USG系列防火墻）。
具備網絡割接、網絡改造項目實戰經驗，能够獨立撰寫割接方案。
• 粵語及英語流利
2. 綜合素質
具備優秀的客戶溝通與跨部門協作能力，能够應對高壓力下的緊急故障處理。
具備良好的文檔撰寫習慣，

入職條件:
申請人必須 -
>(a) 持有香港任何一所大學頒授的資訊科技學士學位，或同等學歷；
>(b) 在取得有關學歷後具備最少四年在資訊保安範疇的工作經驗，如資訊科技安全審核、資訊科技安全事故應變、資訊科技安全風險管理及資訊科技安全遵行；
>(c) 取得至少一項以下資訊科技安全認證：註冊信息安全專業人員(CISP)、註冊信息安全員(CISM)、國際電腦稽核師認證(CISA)、國際資訊安全經理人認證(CISM)或註冊資訊系統安全師(CISSP)；
>(d) 具備優良的溝通技巧及良好中英文會話及書寫能力；及
>(e) 符合語文能力要求，即在香港中學文憑考試或香港中學會考中國語文科和英國語文科考獲第2級或以上成績，或具同等成績〔註(1)〕。
註:
(1) 政府在聘任時，2007年前的香港中學會考中國語文科和英國語文科（課程乙）E級成績，在行政上會被視為等同2007年或之後香港中學會考中國語文科和英國語文科第2級成績。
職責:
資訊科技主任主要負責 -
>(1) 協助項目經理協調和監察有關推行2026年人口普查資訊科技項目的所有活動；
>(2) 提供技術支援和監察資訊科技基礎設施和資訊科技保安事務，包括檢視資訊科技系統安全風險評估報告和資訊科技系統安全審核報告及推行保安措施；
>(3) 參考最新的國內及國際標準和業界良好作業，研究、評估、採購、安裝、維護和支援電腦硬件、軟件、通訊網絡、資訊科技專業服務和系統託管服務；
>(4) 協助聯繫及協調相關方面，包括用戶、承辦商及其他決策局／部門，以推行資訊科技項目；
>(5) 根據政府標準和用戶需求進行系統分析／設計／修改／維修／護理，及其他資訊科技系統技術研究；
>(6) 編製系統規格和其他系統文件；
>(7) 進行系統測試和驗收測試；及
>(8) 執行其他相關工作。
聘用條款:
獲取錄的申請人會按非公務員合約條款受聘，為期約12個月。續約與否視乎受聘人的工作表現及屆時本處的服務需要而定。
福利:
本處會根據《僱傭條例》的規定，在適用的情況下給予年假、休息日、法定假日（或代替假日）、產假、侍產假和疾病津貼。
如受聘人在整個合約期內一直維持良好的工作表現和行為，在合約圓滿結束後可獲約滿酬金。該筆酬金，連同政府根據《強制性公積金計劃條例》的規定為受聘人向強制性公積金計劃所作的供款，將相等於合約期所得底薪總額的百分之十。
附註:
(1) 除另有指明外，申請人於獲聘時必須已成為香港特別行政區永久性居民。
>(2) 作為提供平等就業機會的僱主，政府致力消除在就業方面的歧視。所有符合基本入職條件的人士，不論其殘疾、性別、婚姻狀況、懷孕、年齡、家庭崗位、性傾向和種族，均可申請本欄內的職位。
>(3) 非公務員職位並不是公務員編制內的職位。應徵者如獲聘用，將不會按公務員聘用條款和服務條件聘用。獲聘的應徵者並非公務員，並不會享有獲調派、晉升或轉職至公務員職位的資格。
>(4) 入職薪酬、聘用條款及服務條件，應以獲聘時之規定為準。
>(5) 如果符合訂明入職條件的應徵者人數眾多，招聘部門可以訂立篩選準則，甄選條件較佳的應徵者，以便進一步處理。在此情況下，只有獲篩選的應徵者會獲邀參加遴選面試。
>(6) 政府的政策，是盡可能安排殘疾人士擔任適合的職位。殘疾人士申請職位，如其符合入職條件，毋須再經篩選，便會獲邀參加遴選面試。在適合受聘而有申報為殘疾的申請人和適合受聘程度相若的其他申請人當中，招聘當局可給予前者適度的優先錄用機會。有關政府聘用殘疾人士的政策及其他相關措施載列於《用人唯才：殘疾人士申請政府職位》的資料冊內。申請人可於公務員事務局互聯網站參閱該資料冊，網址如下：：https://www.csb.gov.hk 內的 “公務員隊伍的管理-聘任”。
>(7) 持有本港以外學府/非香港考試及評核局頒授的學歷人士亦可申請，惟其學歷必須經過評審以確定是否與職位所要求的本地學歷水平相若。有關申請人須以電郵方式遞交修業成績表副本及證書副本到••••@censtatd.gov.hk 。
>(8) 在臨近截止申請日期，接受網上申請的伺服器可能因為需要處理大量申請而非常繁忙。申請人應盡早遞交申請，以確保在限期前成功於網上完成申請程序。
申請手續:
(a) 申請人必須透過公務員事務局的 G.F. 340網上申請系統 (https://www.csb.gov.hk) 作網上申請。
>(b) 學歷（包括中國語文及英國語文科成績，證書及正式的修業成績表）、技術資格及工作經驗的證明文件副本，須於截止申請日期或之前以電郵方式遞交到••••@censtatd.gov.hk 。電郵標題須清楚註明「申請資訊科技主任職位」及在電郵和附件名稱註明網上申請編號。為避免電郵傳送延誤或失敗，所有相關證明文件副本應盡量合併成一個檔案，檔案大小不超過25 MB。
>(c) 申請如逾期遞交或資料不全，或並非使用指定申請表格，或以親身、郵寄、傳真或電郵方式提交，或沒有提交相關證明文件副本，或相關證明文件副本在上述日期之後才收到，或所遞交的證明文件不足，有關申請將不獲受理。
>(d) 申請人必須在申請表格上清楚填寫個人的電郵地址。申請人如獲邀參加遴選面試，通常會在截止申請日期後約二至四個星期內以電郵方式接獲通知（申請人有責任確保所提供的電郵地址能接收有關獲邀通知）。如申請人未獲邀參加遴選面試，則可視作經已落選。

title: 自拍機技術員 / 高級自拍機技術員 (Photo Booth Technician / Senior Photo Booth Technician)
teaser: 負責自拍機的保養、維修及故障排查，包括硬件調試、線路配接、付款裝置、網絡及系統測試、處理日常及緊急維修
jd:
公司簡介
SNAPIO 為本地原創自拍機品牌，致力喚起「Capture the moment」的實體照片儀式感。品牌現於香港、澳門及台灣超過 40 間商場設有自拍亭，並與多個大型商場、知名品牌 IP、婚禮及活動單位合作。業務涵蓋硬件組裝、系統開發、相框設計及技術支援，為顧客提供一站式互動攝影體驗。
工作職責
• 負責自拍機的保養、維修及故障排查，包括硬件調試、線路配接、付款裝置、網絡及系統測試
• 處理日常及緊急維修：優先遠端快速排除故障（重啟／網絡／付款），需要時到場跟進，負責零件更換與功能驗證
• 協助運送、安裝及拆卸自拍機，並支援活動機出機、收機及裱機（有機會需配合凌晨或非標準時段工作）
• 撰寫及維護維修紀錄、零件出入庫記錄與運送日誌，並於團隊系統即時更新工單狀態
• 提供活動現場之技術支援，具備靈活應變能力者優先
• （高級技術員）制定及執行預防保養計劃、跟進重複性故障，並指導初級技術員、協助建立標準作業流程
任職要求
• 中六或以上學歷
• 對硬件維修 / 電子 / 機電有興趣、肯動手處理故障；具相關經驗者更佳
◦ 技術員：歡迎應屆畢業生或無相關經驗人士，入職後提供在職培訓
◦ 高級技術員：具 3 年或以上機電／電子／自助機維修經驗，能獨立判斷、處理複雜故障並帶領初級同事
• 懂基本電腦、網絡及系統重裝操作
• 主動溝通及回報，清晰交代維修進度
• 具攝影、付款終端或硬件維修經驗者為佳
• 能配合輪班工作
• 良好中、英文書寫及溝通能力
薪酬與福利
• 14 天有薪年假、法定假期及生日假
• 彈性排班制度
• 提供團體醫療保險

title: Asst. Customer Service Officer
location: Tseung Kwan O Industrial Estate, Sai Kung District
teaser: As an Assistant Customer Service Officer at Avery Dennison, manage customer inquiries, process orders, and coordinate teams for timely delivery.
jd:
Company Description
Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in nearly 60 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.
>
AVERY DENNISON IS PROUD TO BE CERTIFIED GREAT PLACE TO WORK IN AUSTRALIA, BANGLADESH, CHINA, INDIA, INDONESIA, MALAYSIA, SINGAPORE, THAILAND AND VIETNAM, AND RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF THE BEST COMPANIES TO WORK FOR IN ASIA IN GREATER CHINA AND VIETNAM.
>
ABOUT YOUR ROLE
As an Assistant Customer Service Officer, you will focus on providing excellent service by managing customer inquiries and processing orders accurately. You will collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction and support efficient business operations.
>
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE
Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email, phone, and other channels in a timely and professional manner.
Handle order processing and system updates within the required time frame.
Coordinate with production, warehouse, and logistics teams to ensure on-time delivery.
Assist to monitor the inventory level and prepare sales related reports (e.g. daily sales report).
To assist, back up and provide support to other team members.
Samples arrangement.
>
WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU
High school diploma or equivalent, preferably with some experience in customer service or a related field (facing customer is must).
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) and basic computer skills.
Ability to multitask, prioritize work, and work under pressure.
Strong attention to detail and a customer-oriented mindset.
Good team player with a positive attitude.
>
AVERY DENNISON IS AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY PROVIDER.

title: DevOps Research Engineer — AI Incident Investigation
teaser: The successful candidate will lead hands-on research and development of a read-only AI investigation agent for the company's software platform
jd:
EYT3 Limited (“EYT3”) is a Pure-Play Cybersecurity and FinTech / Regulatory Technology (RegTech) company based in Hong Kong. The group established in 2016. We specialize in helping organizations to transform to the new digital era through client centric approach and long-term trusted advisor. We are experts in niche areas such as Security Detection and Response, Cyber Threat Protection for Industrial Automation and IoT and Data Analytics for Financial Crime and Fraud Investigation.
Role Overview
A full-time, permanent applied-research position. The successful candidate will lead hands-on research and development of a read-only AI investigation agent for the company's software platform — one that correlates alerts, logs, health checks, and release notes, forms root-cause hypotheses, and cites the evidence behind every recommendation. The role centres on building and evaluating this investigation capability in a laboratory setting; the platform's DevOps environment serves as the research testbed.
Responsibilities
Research Environment & Signal Engineering (R&D Testbed)
Engineer and maintain the laboratory research environment for the project: the CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes-based testbed, and deployment tooling used to generate, capture, and replay operational signals for experimentation.
Research and map the platform's operational signals — alerts, application and deploy logs, health checks, and release/change notes — identifying owners, formats, and access paths for each source as inputs to the investigation agent.
Study the platform's infrastructure failure modes and compile a failure-mode catalogue (target ≥12 modes, including deploy regression, certificate/TLS failure, dependency timeout, resource pressure, post-release health degradation, and alert storms).
Conduct a structured survey of published Agentic SRE and incident-agent approaches (including hyperscaler SRE-agent systems) and maintain a capability matrix comparing their methods.
Agent Research & Laboratory Prototype
Research, design, and implement a read-only investigation agent: a tool-calling LLM workflow operating under a strict allow-list (fetch alert, search logs by service and time window, get health status, get last release, write investigation record), with no shell access and no production mutation APIs.
Build the signal ingestion and normalisation layer for the four read-only signal types, including desensitisation and synthetic incident generation for laboratory use.
Develop an evidence-citation mechanism so that every hypothesis and recommendation carries pointers to retrieved artefacts (log lines, health JSON fields, release identifiers).
Produce structured investigation briefs following a defined output schema: timeline, suspected service, likely change event, evidence citations, recommended next step, confidence, and audit id.
Experimentation & Evaluation
Curate and label a synthetic incident pack of at least 12 scenarios across six fixed failure families, with seeded ground truth.
Design and execute the evaluation protocol — measuring evidence-citation rate, faulty-service identification rate, and audit completeness — and analyse results across agent configurations, retrieval windows, and hypothesis-ranking strategies.
Implement the audit schema (alert id, queries run, documents retrieved, hypothesis text, recommendation, model/tool versions, timestamp) and verify that every investigation brief is fully reconstructable from the audit log.
Trials, Governance & Knowledge Transfer
Re-run the scenario pack in a controlled sandbox environment that more closely resembles operations, and analyse changes in agent performance.
Support practitioner review sessions of investigation briefs and write up consultation notes.
Draft runbook templates the agent is permitted to suggest (e.g. restart instance, roll back to last good version, renew certificate, silence duplicate alert) — templates only, for human execution.
Collaborate with product, platform, and operations teams to specify how the research outcomes sit beside the existing product as an internal operations copilot.
Document the architecture, evaluation protocol, and policy matrix; produce research reports, an implementation guide, and a module specification.
Stay up to date with research in agentic AI, LLM tool-use, and incident-response automation, and incorporate relevant advances into the investigation workflow.
Skills and Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or equivalent research experience is advantageous.
2+ years of experience in backend, platform, SRE, or DevOps engineering; candidates with less experience will be considered for a junior position.
Proficiency in Python and scripting for log/data processing; experience building against LLM APIs (tool-calling / function-calling patterns) is highly desirable.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and experience with tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or similar, applied here to building the project's experimental testbed.
Experience with Kubernetes is required; OpenShift experience is advantageous.
Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, and with cloud platforms, is advantageous.
Working knowledge of observability and operations tooling: log pipelines, alerting systems, health-check endpoints, and release processes.
Understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or agent evaluation methods is a strong plus.
A rigorous, evidence-first research working style: comfortable designing experiments with labelled ground truth and measurable success criteria.
Strong technical writing skills — the role produces labelled datasets, evaluation protocols, audit schemas, and formal research reports.
Strong problem-solving skills, teamwork, and communication skills.
Fluent in English and Cantonese.
What We Offer
5-day work week
Flexible working hours and work-from-home policy
Performance bonus
Medical insurance
Job-related course sponsorship
The opportunity to conduct applied research on agentic AI for operations, working in a dedicated laboratory environment with direct mentorship from senior technical leadership
Interested candidates, please send your resume, including your current and expected salary, as well as your availability, by clicking "Quick apply".

>(a)(i) 在香港中學文憑考試五科包括中國語文科和英國語文科考獲第2級或同等或以上成績[註(1)]，或具同等學歷；或
>(ii) 在香港中學會考五科包括中國語文科和英國語文科考獲第2級／E級或以上成績[註(2)]，或具同等學歷；
>(b) 具備最少四年於電話中心或客戶服務中心的全職工作經驗[註(3)]，曾於政府或公共機構工作者佔優；
>(c) 操流利英語、粵語和普通話；
>(d) 熟悉一般電腦應用程式（例如MS Word 和 Excel）和中、英文文書處理；以及
>(e) 具備良好的溝通技巧，能獨立工作。
註:
(1) 在聘任時，香港中學文憑考試應用學習科目（最多計算兩科）「達標」成績，以及其他語言科目E級成績，會被視為相等於新高中科目第2級成績。
>(2) 在聘任時，2007年前香港中學會考中國語文科和英國語文科（課程乙）E級成績，在行政上會被視為等同2007年或之後香港中學會考中國語文科和英國語文科第2級成績。
>(3) 實習、自由職業或義工服務的經驗，均不會被視為全職工作經驗。
職責:
(a) 通過電話和其他電子方式（例如電郵、網上平台和傳真）處理公眾的查詢及投訴；
>(b) 管理客戶服務熱線並登記個案；
>(c) 妥善保存個案紀錄及編製統計報告；
>(d) 進行與查詢及投訴相關的統計調查；以及
>(e) 執行上級指派的其他職務。
獲取錄者可能被調派至沙田、荃灣或其他地點工作。
其他相關的工作要求：工作時間及地點或會按部門的運作需要而變更。獲取錄者可能需要輪班及超時工作，包括在晚上、周末、周日和公眾假期工作。
聘用條款:
獲取錄者會按非公務員合約條款聘用，為期一年。
福利:
有薪年假為14天。政府會按照《僱傭條例》的規定，在適當情況下向受聘人提供休息日、法定假日（或代替假日）、產假／侍產假和疾病津貼。受聘人如能圓滿履行合約，而期間一直表現理想兼行為良好，可獲發約滿酬金。該筆酬金（如獲發放），連同政府按《強制性公積金計劃條例》的規定為受聘人向強制性公積金計劃所作的供款，將相等於受聘人在合約期內所得底薪總額的10%。
附註:
(a) 除另有指明外，申請人於獲聘時必須已成為香港特別行政區永久性居民。
>(b) 作為提供平等就業機會的僱主，政府致力消除在就業方面的歧視。所有符合基本入職條件的人士，不論其殘疾、性別、婚姻狀況、懷孕、年齡、家庭崗位、性傾向和種族，均可申請本欄內的職位。
>(c) 非公務員職位並不是公務員編制內的職位。申請人如獲聘用，將不會按公務員聘用條款和服務條件聘用。獲聘用者並非公務員，並不會享有獲調派、晉升或轉職至公務員職位的資格。
>(d) 入職薪酬、聘用條款及服務條件，應以獲聘時的規定為準。
>(e) 如果符合訂明入職條件的應徵者人數眾多，招聘部門可以訂立篩選準則，甄選條件較佳的應徵者，以便進一步處理。在此情況下，只有獲篩選的申請人會獲邀參加招聘考試╱面試。
>(f) 政府的政策，是盡可能安排殘疾人士擔任適合的職位。殘疾人士申請職位，如其符合入職條件，毋須再經篩選，便會獲邀參加面試╱筆試。在適合受聘而有申報為殘疾人士的申請人和適合受聘程度相若的其他申請人當中，招聘當局可給予前者適度的優先錄用機會。有關政府聘用殘疾人士的政策及其他相關措施載列於《用人唯才：殘疾人士申請政府職位》的資料冊內。
>(g) 持有本港以外學府╱非香港考試及評核局頒授學歷的人士亦可申請，惟其學歷必須經過評審以確定是否與職位所要求的本地學歷水平相若。有關申請人須在截止申請日期或之前，將修業成績副本和證書副本電郵至••••@epd.gov.hk 。電郵標題及副本的每一頁均須註明申請職位的名稱及網上申請編號。
>(h) 在臨近截止申請日期，接受網上申請的伺服器可能因為需要處理大量申請而非常繁忙。申請人應盡早遞交申請，以確保在限期前成功於網上完成申請程序。
申請手續:
(1) 申請人必須於截止申請日期或之前透過公務員事務局的G.F. 340網上申請系統作網上申請。
>(2) 在提交網上申請後，申請人須於截止申請日期或之前透過電郵提交有關文件副本，以證明其：
>(i) 相關學歷；以及

>申請人須在電郵標題中及上述文件副本的每一頁上註明申請職位的名稱及其網上申請編號。
>(3) 申請表格填報的資料不全、或以親身、郵寄、傳真或電郵方式遞交、或未於截止申請日期或以前遞交上述第(2)項所列文件的申請，將不獲受理。
>(4) 申請人須於申請表格上提供一個電郵地址。申請人如獲邀參加遴選面試，通常會於截止申請日期起計八個星期內透過電郵方式接獲通知。如遇到申請人數眾多或其他特殊情況，可能需時稍長。申請人如未獲邀參加遴選面試，可視作經已落選。

title: Full-stack Engineer (With right to work in HK only)
teaser: Full-Stack Engineer to architect and deploy an end-to-end e-commerce platform for AI-powered precision health startup.
jd:
About the role
PawtholoGene Lab is seeking an experienced, independent Full-Stack Engineer to architect, build, and deploy an end-to-end e-commerce platform from the ground up, translating business requirements into a functional, production-ready web application. This platform will serve as the primary storefront and secure user portal for delivering personalized supplement recommendations. You will execute a full-cycle web build—spanning from UI/UX design to database management and cloud deployment—for a fast-paced, science-driven startup.
Key responsibilities
UI/UX Design: Translate product vision into wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes using Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar design tools.
Frontend Development: Build a responsive, fast-loading, and SEO-optimized e-commerce storefront with complex client-side state management (shopping carts, persistent sessions, filters).
Backend Architecture: Develop secure, scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs to handle business logic, including user authentication (RBAC, JWT), order processing, and inventory control.
Database Management: Architect and optimize a hybrid database strategy using Relational (SQL) databases for transactional data (orders, billing) and Non-Relational (NoSQL) databases for flexible data models (product catalogs, user sessions).
Payment & Third-Party Integration: Seamlessly integrate secure payment gateways, local Hong Kong methods, and cross-border payment options (e.g., FPS, PayMe, Alipay HK, WeChat Pay HK, Alipay & WeChat Pay (Mainland China), UnionPay, Credit Cards) and automated email notification services (e.g., SendGrid, AWS SES).
Cloud Deployment & DevOps: Set up cloud infrastructure on AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), ensuring high availability, continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD), and proper SSL/TLS configurations.
About you
5+ years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Developer, with a proven portfolio of launching operational e-commerce or SaaS platforms.
Proficiency in modern UI/UX design software (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Penpot) with a strong understanding of user-centered design, typography, and responsive layouts.
Mastery of modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js) and state management libraries.
Deep expertise in backend ecosystems such as Node.js (Express/NestJS), or Python (Django/FastAPI).
Hands-on proficiency with SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
Proven experience deploying applications using AWS (EC2, S3, RDS) or GCP (App Engine, Compute Engine), alongside containerization tools like Docker.
Practical knowledge of web security best practices (OWASP Top 10, data encryption, CORS, secure cookie handling).
Strong problem-solving abilities, exceptional time management, and the ability to work completely independently without daily supervision.
>

1. 负责公司硬件研发整体战略与技术路线制定，带领硬件团队围绕高通 S1 平台、TWS 无线音频硬件、EVB 评估板进行产品方案设计、电路开发、样机调试与量产落地。
2. 统筹对接高通客户技术需求，把客户业务需求转化为硬件开发方案，管控项目进度、研发成本与产品性能，解决关键硬件技术难点。
3. 搭建并优化硬件开发流程、研发规范，管理研发项目全生命周期（立项‑方案‑测试‑量产交付）。
4. 带领跨地研发团队，协调香港与深圳技术资源，负责核心技术攻关，指导工程师完成电路设计、硬件除错、可靠性测试。
5. 评估行业新技术、元器件方案，平衡研发成本与产品竞争力，支撑公司技术服务产品商业交付。
6. 向 CEO 直接汇报，参与公司技术与商务重大决策。
>
任职资格及要求（硬性门坎）
1. 电子信息、电子工程或相关专业本科或以上学历。
2. 不少于 15 年消费电子 / 通信硬件完整研发经验，其中包含 5 年及以上硬件研发团队管理经验；有大型通信电子企业硬件开发部门管理经历优先。
3. 具备 TWS、蓝牙音频、无线通信硬件方案开发、样机调试、量产落地完整经验；有高通芯片平台项目实战经验优先。
4. 能够独立主持硬件项目全流程，可处理电路设计、硬件除错、跨部门、跨地域团队协调工作。
5. 熟悉硬件研发规范，有对接海外头部芯片厂商客户的项目交付经验。
6. 良好中英文沟通能力，可与海外客户进行技术对接。

title: Full-Stack App Developer
teaser: We are building innovative audio-focused mobile applications. We are looking for a full stack engineer who can drive app development from back end...
jd:
About Us
We are building innovative audio-focused mobile applications. We are looking for a full stack engineer who can drive app development from back end to front end.
The Role
As our Full Stack Engineer, you will drive the complete product development lifecycle:
Develop and maintain the mobile app (Flutter, iOS/Android) with feature iterations and performance optimization
Design and build scalable Python backend APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
Manage app submissions, releases, and reviews on App Store, Google Play, and other app marketplaces
Deploy and operate services on Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run) and Alibaba Cloud
Work independently from requirement analysis to design, development, testing, and production deployment
What We Are Looking For
3+ years of full stack development experience; CS degree or equivalent
Strong hands-on experience with Flutter (Dart) and proven iOS/Android app store releases
Strong Python skills with production experience in Flask or FastAPI
Experience integrating Firebase authentication in both mobile and backend systems
Solid PostgreSQL knowledge, including database design and query optimization
Experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL) and/or Alibaba Cloud deployments
Key: Ability and willingness to independently take responsibility for products and drive projects without large team support
Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies
Nice to Have
Mobile audio streaming development experience (background playback, media controls, low-latency optimization)
Audio signal processing or audio data knowledge
Top 100 university degree (subject ranking on QS/Times/US News/ShanghaiRanking)
LLM or AI application development experience
Strong craftsmanship mindset; communicative and resilient
Other Info
We are incubated by PolyU's advanced research labs with exclusive audio processing and streaming technologies that are not available elsewhere. Work with cutting-edge algorithms powering our differentiated product.
Drive complete mobile app development and see your impact directly in a real, growing user base.
Join a team rooted in Hong Kong Polytechnic University's research excellence, with access to advanced lab resources and collaboration opportunities.
Monthly salary: 20K-35K

title: Security Engineer (Web3)
teaser: Monitor and evaluate the security landscape of Web3 technologies to stay ahead of emerging threats and exploit trends.
jd:
Key Responsibilities
Implement security measures and protocols for decentralized applications (dApps) to protect against vulnerabilities and ensure robust system performance.
Conduct security audits and testing of smart contracts, identifying and mitigating potential exploits before they can be leveraged by malicious actors.
Collaborate with the development team to integrate security best practices throughout the application lifecycle, from design through deployment.
Monitor and evaluate the security landscape of Web3 technologies to stay ahead of emerging threats and exploit trends.
Provide incident response for security breaches, conduct forensic analysis, and help develop strategies to prevent recurrence.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
Proficient understanding of blockchain technologies, decentralized systems, and smart contract development.
Experience with security auditing tools and techniques specific to blockchain applications.
Strong knowledge of various security protocols, cryptographic principles, and best practices in the blockchain space.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with programming languages commonly used in blockchain (e.g., Solidity, JavaScript, Go) is a strong advantage.
